paper_metadata.title: BLS-QLSTM: a novel hybrid quantum neural network for stock index forecasting

experiments.description: Hybrid BLS-QLSTM stock index forecasting experiment on CSI 300 using phase-space reconstruction, broad learning feature expansion, and QLSTM prediction.

algorithm.variant: BLS-QLSTM (Broad Learning System + Quantum Long Short-Term Memory)
algorithm.ansatz: VQC-based LSTM gates; angle-encoding VQC with H, Ry, Rz, CNOT, and R gates

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Original one-dimensional closing-price series is phase-space reconstructed into 7-dimensional vectors, then concatenated with BLS-expanded features and fed to QLSTM; VQC encodes classical inputs via rotation gates (Ry/Rz) after H gate initialization.
problem_formulation.objective_function: Forecast next-day stock index closing price and derive up/down trend classification from predicted vs previous-day price change.

problem_instance.description: CSI 300 index daily closing-price forecasting and direction prediction.

dataset_specification.description: Daily closing prices from 2013-01-04 to 2023-12-29 (excluding holidays), retrieved from Investing.com; phase-space reconstruction with m=7, tau=16; reconstructed matrix size 2576 x 7; BLS-expanded to 16 dimensions; 75% train / 25% test; stable labels (|daily change| <= 1%) filtered out for direction classification.

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Cao method and mutual information for phase-space reconstruction; BLS feature expansion; standardization; inverse standardization for outputs; up/down labels from 1% threshold and filtering of stable samples.
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Inverse standardization; compute RMSE, MAE, MAPE, R2, precision, and accuracy; compare predicted and actual trend labels.

speedup_claims.factor: 21.6% lower RMSE than LSTM; 6.3% lower RMSE than QLSTM
speedup_claims.conditions: CSI 300 stock index forecasting with phase-space reconstruction (m=7, tau=16), BLS feature expansion, and 75/25 train-test split
speedup_claims.caveats: Claim is based on one dataset and reported test metrics; no runtime speedup reported.
